issues.label: Cash Flow Crisis
issues.summary: Farm operating costs exceed revenue, threatening season viability

circuits.detail: Finance systems overwhelmed by debt service and operating cost pressure
Market signals misread under financial pressure, suboptimal selling decisions
Production scaled back due to capital constraints on inputs
Fertilizer and nutrient purchasing reduced below optimal rates
Equipment maintenance deferred, increasing breakdown risk
Land lease decisions forced by cash needs rather than agronomic fit

issues.label: Supply Chain Breakdown
issues.summary: Critical input delivery or product distribution disrupted

circuits.detail: Transport routes and cold chain broken, product stranded in pipeline
Fertilizer delivery delayed past application window
Post-harvest sorting and routing bottlenecked by logistics failure
Processing facilities idled due to raw material shortage
Livestock feed supply disrupted, forcing emergency sourcing

issues.label: Drought / Input Shortage
issues.summary: Water availability critically below crop and livestock requirements

circuits.detail: Water systems overwhelmed — aquifer levels dropping, allocation cuts
Crop yields declining from moisture stress across growth stages
Soil structure degrading — cracking, compaction, loss of biology
Livestock water consumption restricted, weight gain declining
Specialty crops failing first — highest water demand, lowest tolerance
Seed variety selections mismatched to drought conditions

issues.label: Market Price Collapse
issues.summary: Commodity prices drop below cost of production

circuits.detail: Market pricing signals chaotic — basis, futures, and spot diverging
Revenue projections shattered, loan covenants at risk of breach
Production planning paralyzed — unclear whether to plant or idle
Distribution contracts renegotiated mid-season under duress
Policy intervention demands spike — emergency farm bill provisions sought
Processors reducing purchases as retail demand contracts

issues.label: Equipment Failure
issues.summary: Critical machinery breakdown during peak operational window

circuits.detail: Primary equipment down — planting or harvest window closing
Precision ag systems offline — GPS, sensors, variable-rate controllers
Field operations halted pending repair or replacement
Irrigation pumps or pivot systems failed during critical period
Drying and handling equipment bottlenecked at harvest

issues.label: Pest / Disease Outbreak
issues.summary: Biological threat exceeds integrated pest management capacity

circuits.detail: Crop protection systems overwhelmed — pest pressure beyond spray thresholds
Crop stand compromised — yield loss from insect or disease damage
Specialty crops devastated — high-value, low-tolerance varieties hit hardest
Seed genetics lacking resistance traits for emerging pest complex
Soil-borne pathogens building — nematode or fungal pressure increasing
Emergency research and extension response mobilized
